'''Tikkit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who resided in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was a patron of the [[Thirsty Bantha]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], and dreamed of one day becoming a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] captain.
